inputs: existing frozen quarantined raw bars/factors/financials/reports/calendar only; no new authenticated capture
money_cost_risk_policy: UNSET_REQUIRED; no account or strategy-profit simulation
labels: RAW_UNADJUSTED_PRICE_CHANGE_ONLY; no fee-inclusive/total/portfolio return; actions and status unresolved remain explicit exclusion
calendar_policy: if frozen current-reference calendar complete, reconstruct next5/20/60open sessions with reference-source lineage but no historicalPITclaim; absent/incomplete => session labelUNKNOWN, separate clearly named observed-bar-offset descriptive labels allowed
row_policy: sort by symbol/date, retain all original/duplicate/conflicting observations; no silently overwrite conflict, no flat fabricated bar, missing future endpointUNKNOWN
timing_price_component: exact price-only subconditions of two frozen families; sectorRS/company/valuation/catalyst/Edge/status/action gates not assumed, complete family decision alwaysNO_DECISION when unknown
feature_prefix: only observation trade_date<=diagnostic cutoff; actual available/retrieved/source clocks preserved as current-reconstruction, not rewritten into historical first availability
label_separation: future labels are reveal-only outputs; not passed to feature/eligibility calculation; truncate/futuremutation prefix noninterference tests
quality: current WaveC/WaveD coordinates and point-in-time/current financial field/missingness lineage; no backfill todayQuality into historical price decisions; no quality-to-future predictive claim without asof financial evidence
chronological_price_diagnostics: fixed chronological expanding price-only blocks, no fitting/tuning; all retrospective exposed; complete final60label purge at block boundary; no walk-forward formal/OOS claim

sensitivity.rule: alter only stated volume subcondition separately; report every membership/coverage flip and unknown, no winner ranking or candidate parameter mutation, no objective search

reporting: rawpricechange distribution quantiles and rawpath drawdown, decimal strings
double deterministic byte-identical replay after freeze; preserve failedepochs
